Fourth RBA rate hike looms amid home-grown inflation; analysts warn house prices could fall 10%
Property developer distress intensifies: Bathla warns of potential collapse; 'Evergrande moment' narrative gains traction
Coal sector sees a boom, supporting energy names; diesel shock persists
CSL signs Trump administration deal to slash medicine prices, creating margin pressure for healthcare
Qantas ground crews vote for right to strike amid pay dispute

sectors.trend: Mixed: coal boom supports energy miners; gold exploration positives (King River, Moonlight) lift junior miners; tungsten/titanium/antimony discoveries add breadth. However, oil-driven inflation fears pressure base metals via rate-hike risk.
sectors.implications: Coal names (WDS.AX, BRL.AX) benefit from energy security premium. Gold juniors (KRV.AX, MLT.AX) see speculative inflows. BHP.AX, RIO.AX face headwind from higher yields and potential demand slowdown. Mineral Resources (MIN.AX) clears ASIC overhang.

sectors.trend: Negative. Fourth RBA hike looms; property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes; developer defaults (Bathla) raise NPL concerns. CBA fee controversy adds reputational risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate cycle peak and housing stress. Credit losses in property lending could compress earnings. Defensive dividend appeal intact but upside limited.

sectors.trend: Positive. Oil at two-month high on US-Iran strikes; coal boom; diesel shock structural. Big batteries face AEMO regulatory scrutiny.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BRL.AX, SAI.AX benefit from elevated oil/coal. Battery/storage names (e.g., FTS.AX) face regulatory headwind. Energy transition policy uncertainty persists.

sectors.trend: Negative near-term. CSL's Trump administration price-cut deal signals global margin compression for Australian pharma/biotech.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX faces pricing pressure in US market; offset by volume growth potential. Short-term sentiment hit; long-term depends on deal terms. SSW.AX, SXW.AX less directly affected.

sectors.trend: Negative. Qantas strike risk; per capita recession fears; retail bankruptcies (US Chapter 11 filings); housing affordability crisis suppresses consumer spending.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption risk from ground crew strike. WES.AX, WTW.AX, IAG.AX under pressure from weak consumer confidence. Star Entertainment (SGH.AX) management transition adds uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Highly negative. 10% house price fall forecast; developer implosions; negative gearing 'rent bomb' fails to ignite; property investor credit growth crashes.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICPS.AX) face rising vacancy and refinancing risk at higher rates. Residential developers (DHG.AX, LVH.AX) at elevated default risk. Bathla collapse signals broader sector stress.

sectors.trend: Globally positive but with contagion risk. OpenAI ad revenue hits $1B; Cathie Wood buys Cerebras; AI infrastructure plays (Corning, Applied Materials, Micron) active. Central banker warns of AI-driven downturn risk.
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but sentiment spillover. Local tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from global AI capex cycle. Contagion risk is a tail risk for all equities.

RBA fourth rate hike imminent; home-grown inflation (housing, services) keeps cycle extended
Housing market correction: 10% price fall forecast, developer defaults, credit contraction
Coal/energy security premium supports Australian thermal coal exporters
CSL-US pricing deal signals global pharma margin compression
AI disruption: both opportunity (capex) and systemic risk (central bank warning)
Per capita recession narrative gaining traction

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor Brent crude; consider AUD/USD short as oil-driven inflation pressures AUD

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leverage; favour fixed-income and dividend-paying defensives; avoid rate-sensitive REITs and property developers
Avoid residential REITs and small-cap developers; monitor NAB/CBA property loan NPLs; consider short exposure to property builders
Reduce QAN.AX exposure pre-strike vote; monitor Qantas share price for event-driven volatility
Maintain diversified portfolio; monitor global tech valuations; central bank commentary at Jackson Hole

risk_assessment.mitigation: Assess CSL.AX deal terms; consider whether volume offsets price cuts; monitor CSL guidance

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gold junior exposure on exploration positives
opportunities.rationale: King River 44g/t and Moonlight Q3 results support gold exploration narrative; safe-haven bid from geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate quality dividend defensives (banks, staples) on ASX selloff
opportunities.rationale: ASX tumble creates entry point; banks still profitable; WES/WTW resilient to mild recession

defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house price fall forecast; developer defaults (Bathla); credit growth crash; negative gearing fails to support rents

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Qantas with put options or reduce position ahead of strike vote

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/short-duration bonds; avoid long-duration equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth RBA hike looms; yields spiking; per capita recession risk; global debt spiral concerns

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) likely to open lower on oil spike, yield spike, and rate-hike fears. Geopolitical premium supports energy but broad risk-off dominates. QAN.AX volatile on strike vote. Housing stress keeps REITs and property developers under pressure. Expect 2-4% index decline over 1-2 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Fourth RBA hike likely peaks the cycle but home-grown inflation (housing, services) delays cuts. Housing correction of 5-10% probable but negative gearing failure limits downside. Coal/energy structural tailwind persists. CSL US deal a one-off margin hit. AI capex cycle supports tech globally but contagion risk is a tail. Per capita growth remains subdued.
